## The S4 embed-list saving, measured offline (#14371)

⛔ **OFFLINE — zero provider calls, zero spend, no key read.** Both layouts are `json.dumps` over the SAME objects, counted with `cl100k_base`; the encoder cache was **warm — tiktoken's own reader was never called** (cache dir `/tmp/data-gym-cache`). A regeneration on a box whose encoder cache is COLD fetches the ~1.6 MB of BPE ranks once and records `FETCHED` for ITS OWN run — that changes this line and no cell, so a difference here is the field working, not a disagreement.

Corpus: `tests/eval/write_path/receipts/7947-arms-2026-10-18` (7 sessions / 14 emissions / 580 items). Vertex: `docs/evidence/14277-extractor-cost/measurements.jsonl` arm `cold`. Posture: **production** (every switch read, not asserted: TORTOISE_S4_DELTA=<unset>, TORTOISE_EXTRACTOR_PROMPT=<unset>, TORTOISE_CLASSIFY_LATER=<unset>, TORTOISE_REFERENTIALITY=<unset>, TORTOISE_PACKS_DIR=<unset>, TORTOISE_S4_EMBED_JSON=indent)

The layout seam resolved to **`indent`** — this measurement counts BOTH layouts over the same objects, so its numbers do not depend on that setting; it is recorded because an armed shell must not produce an artifact indistinguishable from a disarmed one.

**1,801 tokens per emission**, and the share spans 29.64%–34.99% across them — a property of the serialization, not of one session. Per item that is `133.7` tokens in `indent=1` against `90.3` compact, so the `43.4`-token difference between the two layouts IS the indentation. The compact copy is also BELOW S2's own emission of `100.9` completion tokens per item; ⛔ those counts do NOT say why (the gap may be formatting, or content the receipt's parsed list does not carry), and nothing here removes it — the saved `25,215` tokens are the indentation alone.

### Tokens per document, before → after

The arithmetic, in the order it is applied:

1. the re-sent embed region is **solved** from the corpus per S4 call: `23,176.0` (provider `prompt_tokens` per call) − `8,562` (the S4 static render) − `2,109.5` (S1's story, re-sent) − `93` (the #10311 untrusted-data envelope) = **12,411.5** tokens — the bundle prints `12,412`, the same solve at whole-token precision. Every term is subtracted because each is charged to its OWN row in the decomposition; omitting the last two gives 14,614.0, which is not this region.
2. S4 takes **1.14** calls per document (50 documents), so the region is `12,411.5 × 1.14` = **14,149.1 tokens/document**;
3. the measured share — `25,215 / 77,561` = 32.5099% — applied to that region: `0.325099 × 14,149.1` = **4,599.9 tokens/document** (4,035.0 per call);
4. the median document is `48,461 in + 16,338 out` = **64,799 tokens**, so after = `64,799 − 4,599.9` = **60,199.1** (**−7.1%**).

| | before | after (`compact`) | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| input tokens / median document | 48,461 | 43,861.1 | −4,599.9 |
| output tokens / median document | 16,338 | 16,338 | 0 (not measured — see ⛔) |
| **tokens / median document** | **64,799** | **60,199.1** | **−4,599.9 (−7.1%)** |

⚠️ The output column is unchanged **by construction** (the prompt's content is identical, its layout smaller) and it is **not measured**: what S4 emits given either layout is exactly the `#7949` capstone's question.

### What the saving would buy — at the allowance levels as given

⛔ The levels below are **inputs** (`#14275`, owner), not re-derived here; every count is a **floor** (`affordable_count`), because a capacity cell that cannot be bought at its tier is wrong in the direction that flatters us.

| tier | allowance | documents/month before | after | the floor, shown |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| solo | 3,000,000 | 46 | **49** | `49 × 60,199.1 = 2,949,755.9 ≤ 3,000,000`; `50 × 60,199.1 = 3,009,955.0` overruns |
| pro | 4,000,000 | 61 | **66** | `66 × 60,199.1 = 3,973,140.6 ≤ 4,000,000`; `67 × 60,199.1 = 4,033,339.7` overruns |
| team | 24,000,000 | 370 | **398** | `398 × 60,199.1 = 23,959,241.8 ≤ 24,000,000`; `399 × 60,199.1 = 24,019,440.9` overruns |

The unit above is printed, and multiplied, at 1 dp; the counts are the floors of the exact unit, and the next document overruns by at least `9,955.0` tokens, so the display precision cannot flip a cell.

That is **+3 / +5 / +28** documents a month (solo / pro / team) — the size of the lever, not a pricing proposal.

### What this measurement does NOT deliver

⛔ The quality re-run on `#7949` is **NOT delivered here**. What the layout does to what the model EMITS (E1 volume / E2 correctness / E3 provenance / E4 operator edges) is unmeasured, so `TORTOISE_S4_EMBED_JSON=compact` stays **OFF**. Arming takes the variable AND the `DOOR_PINNED_OFF` preregistration pin withdrawn in the same change (`#14343` §5.2) — a capstone scored with the variable exported still measures the `indent` render.

### Reproduce

```bash
uv run python tools/extractor_cost_measure.py embed-json \
    --receipts tests/eval/write_path/receipts/7947-arms-2026-10-18 \
    --evidence docs/evidence/14277-extractor-cost/measurements.jsonl \
    --out docs/evidence/14343-amplify/embed-json-offline.md \
    --json-out docs/evidence/14343-amplify/embed-json-offline.json
```

Without the two `--out` flags the command prints this document to stdout and writes nothing — that is a READ, not a regeneration.
